sloka: स उष्णीषैः उत्तम अन्गैः च स अंगदैः बाहुभिः तथा ।ऊरुभिः बाहुभिः च्छिन्नैः नाना रूपैः विभूषणैः ॥३-२५-४३॥
transliteration: sa uṣṇīṣaiḥ uttama angaiḥ ca sa aṁgadaiḥ bāhubhiḥ tathā ।ūrubhiḥ bāhubhiḥ cchinnaiḥ nānā rūpaiḥ vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ॥3-25-43॥

translations.english: Seeing them slain, all the rakshasas were utterly distressed and could not stir against Rama, conqueror of the cities of foes.
